aboutParas: walau01 is where I share that process: the questions, the research, and the trade-offs that survive a closer look.
Most of the writing is about ETFs, portfolio decisions, factor investing, and the costs that are easy to miss. A smaller part is about fitness, AI, work, and everyday life.
I’m sharing what I learn, with room to disagree and change my mind. The aim is a clearer decision, not a louder opinion.

coast.title: Coast FIRE
coast.headline: Let time carry
coast.intro: What if the money you have already invested could grow into your retirement fund? Explore that milestone. You still need income for life along the way.
coast.privacy: Calculated in your browser. Your inputs stay here.
coast.example: Fictional example inputs. Replace them with your own.
coast.inputsIntro: A few numbers. A clearer picture.

retirementAge.label: Retirement age
retirementAge.hint: When this portfolio starts funding retirement

investments.label: Retirement investments today
investments.hint: Assets earmarked for retirement; exclude emergency cash

monthlySpending.label: Monthly retirement spending
monthlySpending.hint: In today’s ringgit; include your expected living costs

monthlyContribution.label: Monthly retirement deposits
monthlyContribution.hint: In today’s ringgit; kept constant after inflation

returnRate.label: Annual return after fees
returnRate.hint: Before inflation; a hypothetical growth assumption

inflationRate.label: Annual inflation
inflationRate.hint: Used to convert growth to purchasing power

withdrawalRate.label: Initial withdrawal rate
withdrawalRate.hint: Annual spending as a share of the retirement portfolio

coast.invalid: Enter values within the displayed limits. Ages must be whole years.
coast.invalidAge: Retirement age must be later than your current age.
coast.resultCaption: Invested today, with no further deposits, to reach your retirement target under these assumptions.
coast.progress: Progress toward today’s Coast FIRE target
coast.ready: Coast target reached in this model
coast.statusReady: Your current investments meet the Coast FIRE target under these assumptions. Current living costs still need funding.
coast.statusFuture: With continued monthly deposits, this model reaches Coast FIRE around age {age}.
coast.statusNotReached: This scenario does not reach Coast FIRE by your retirement age. Explore a different savings amount or review your assumptions.
coast.chartIntro: Compare continuing monthly deposits with letting your existing investments grow.
coast.chartAccessible: Projected investments from age {start} to {end}, with and without new deposits, compared with the retirement target.
coast.methodTitle: See the maths. Keep the assumptions.
coast.methodIntro: A milestone to explore, rather than a date to hand in your notice.
coast.method1: Annual retirement spending divided by your chosen withdrawal rate. This is a planning assumption, not a guaranteed safe rate.
coast.method2: We adjust your after-fee return for inflation, so every result stays in today’s purchasing power.
coast.method3: Discount the retirement target by the years of growth left. That is the amount needed today if you add nothing else.
coast.method4: Deposits are added at month-end and stay constant in real terms. The model finds the first month you could stop adding and still reach the target.
coast.limitations: This is a constant-growth illustration. Taxes, pension income and market volatility are not modelled. It does not test whether a withdrawal rate will survive retirement.
coast.sourceWithdrawal: Fidelity · Estimating a financial independence target
